title: Block minterm
statement: Let $m\ge 7$, choose a block $b\in\{0,\ldots,m-1\}$, and assign a sign in $\{−1,1\}$ to each of the $2m$ positions in that block's assignment. The associated minterm is the conjunction of the $2m$ literals formed from those signs and the corresponding block coordinates among the $2^m$ variables; these coordinates are pairwise distinct.
hypotheses_covered: an assignment of a sign to each of the $2m$ positions
caveat: The coordinate map is defined by upstream declarations not included in the supplied descriptions, so its precise indexing cannot be stated more explicitly.
